changes.summary: generateCycloneDxSbom records every package of a Bun isolated install (node_modules/.bun, the default for workspaces): it skipped the store and found only the root's direct dependencies, so a workspace app's SBOM missed nearly all of its packages

A feed sync answered not_modified now saves the cached snapshot with fetchedAt set to the check, so a feed that has not changed (CISA KEV can go days without a release) no longer reads as stale and blocks admission intelligence signing
